notes.title: Version 1.5 changelog
notes.notes:
New mission type: Soldier Evacuation intended for ND 530C helicopter.
 Improved weather system offering much more diverse environments.
 Checkboxes in the “Controls” section for inverting analog sticks (throttle and yoke Y axis).
 Improved readability of the cockpit map and unit markers on the HUD.
 Posters in the hangar (it's good to stand up from the monitor once in a while and look around).
 Bug fixes and other improvements.
